meta.name: funding
meta.description: Funding round signal tracking for B2B outbound. Use when the user asks about funding signals, Series A/B/C detection, post-raise outreach, budget availability triggers, Crunchbase monitoring, or venture capital signals. Do NOT use for general company events (use company-events skill) or hiring that follows funding (use hiring skill).

copy.tagline: 发现B2B客户融资信号，把握外呼时机
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你做B2B销售，需要根据客户融资动态调整外呼策略
copy.tagline_en: Discover funding signals for B2B outreach timing
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you do B2B sales and need to act on customer funding events

howto.what: 当用户询问融资信号时，Claude 会检测融资轮次（Series A/B/C 等），根据融资额和轮次给出信号评分，并建议最佳联系时机（融资后 2-4 周）。
howto.when: 当用户提到融资信号、系列轮次（如 Series A）、融资后外联、预算可用性触发、Crunchbase 监控或风险资本信号等关键词时触发。

say.text: 跟踪我目标客户的融资轮次。
有一个客户刚融了 B 轮，什么时候联系？
建立一个基于融资的外呼工作流。

howto.what_en: When the user asks about funding signals, Claude detects funding rounds (Series A/B/C etc.), scores them by round size, and suggests optimal outreach timing (weeks 2-4 after announcement).
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user mentions funding signals, series rounds (e.g., Series A), post-raise outreach, budget triggers, Crunchbase monitoring, or venture capital signals.

say_en.text: Track funding rounds for my target accounts.
say_en.note: Claude sets up Crunchbase monitoring, filters, and alerts.

say_en.text: A prospect just raised Series B, when to reach out?
say_en.note: Claude advises the 2-4 week window and to reference growth challenges.
Claude designs a Clay table with funding filters, enrichment, and routing.
